name: Zukappa
source: A Zukappa type monster girl. Zukappa seems to be similar to the [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kappa_%28folklore%29]Kappa[/url] monsters of Japanese folklore and Leo finds this Zukappa at the beach drinking. Surprisingly she's a very good healer for [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] as well rivaling [url=http://vndb.org/c10477]Kusushi[/url]. She seems to have been rather promiscuous prior to meeting Leo.
